# 99 Roots Studio

> Tattoo studio in Berlin Prenzlauer Berg (Prenzlauer Allee 216, 10405 Berlin, Germany) with resident and guest tattoo artists.

## Styles

Fine line, blackwork, ornamental, black & grey realism, micro realism, botanical, illustrative, neo-traditional, neo-tribal, dark illustrative, traditional and minimalist tattoos. Each artist lists their own styles on the website.

## Opening hours

Mon–Wed 10:00–18:00 · Thu 10:30–18:00 · Fri–Sat 10:00–18:00 · Sunday by appointment only. Walk-ins welcome during opening hours.
